en: Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a cobblestone street lined with two‑ and three‑story historic buildings. On the left is a building with flower boxes and a sign reading "Hotel Goldenes Lamm" above an arched entrance, with flagpoles extending from the façade. Similar old town buildings continue down the street. The caption at the bottom of the image identifies the town and street.
